result.question: Should I start bucky irving or Jonathan Taylor
result.answer: Start Jonathan Taylor over Bucky Irving. Jonathan Taylor leads on the two strongest factors: he averages 19.8 PPR points per game versus Bucky Irving's 14.3, and he averaged 18.0 PPR points per game in weeks 4-6 compared to Irving's 14.8. Taylor also holds a stronger weekly opportunity edge with 24.2 touches per game to Irving's 19.5, and faces a more favorable matchup in week 7 (CAR rank 5 vs MIN rank 32).

claims.text: Bucky Irving: TB, RB, roster status ACT (week 7). Jonathan Taylor: IND, RB, roster status ACT (week 7).

evidence.sql: SELECT r.gsis_id, r.full_name, r.team, r.position, r.status, r.week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters r JOIN (SELECT gsis_id, MAX(week) AS week FROM NFLVERSE.rosters WHERE season = 2026 AND REGEXP_REPLACE(LOWER(full_name), ' (jr|sr|ii|iii|iv)[.]?$', '') IN ('jonathan taylor', 'should i', 'i start', 'start bucky', 'bucky irving', 'irving or', 'or jonathan', 'should i start', 'i start bucky', 'start bucky irving', 'bucky irving or', 'irving or jonathan', 'or jonathan taylor') GROUP BY gsis_id) latest ON r.gsis_id = latest.gsis_id AND r.week = latest.week WHERE r.season = 2026 AND r.position IN ('QB', 'RB', 'WR', 'TE') ORDER BY r.full_name

claims.text: Jonathan Taylor averages 24.2 touches per game (23 targets + 122 carries) compared to Bucky Irving's 19.5 touches per game (21 targets + 96 carries), favouring Jonathan Taylor on weekly opportunity.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, ps.week, ps.opponent_team, ROUND(100 * sc.offense_pct, 1) AS snap_pct, ps.targets, ROUND(100 * ps.target_share, 1) AS target_share_pct, ps.receptions, ps.carries, ROUND(ps.fantasy_points_ppr, 1) AS ppr_points FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps LEFT JOIN NFLVERSE.snap_counts sc ON sc.game_id = ps.game_id AND sc.player = ps.player_display_name AND sc.team = ps.team WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0039361', '00-0036223') ORDER BY ps.player_display_name, ps.week

claims.text: Jonathan Taylor averaged 18.3 PPR points per game in weeks 4-7 compared to Bucky Irving's 14.8

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, 3 AS split_week, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS early_games, SUM(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_games, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN ps.fantasy_points_ppr END), 1) AS early_ppr_per_game, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN ps.fantasy_points_ppr END), 1) AS late_ppr_per_game, ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week <= 3 THEN ps.target_share END), 1) AS early_target_share_pct, ROUND(100 * AVG(CASE WHEN ps.week > 3 THEN ps.target_share END), 1) AS late_target_share_pct FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0039361', '00-0036223') GROUP BY ps.player_display_name ORDER BY ps.player_display_name

claims.text: Bucky Irving scores 21% of his PPR points from touchdowns versus Jonathan Taylor's 35.4%, making Irving less touchdown-dependent and steadier.

evidence.sql: SELECT ps.player_display_name AS player, SUM(ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds + ps.passing_tds) AS touchdowns, SUM(6 * (ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) + 4 * ps.passing_tds) AS td_points, ROUND(SUM(ps.fantasy_points_ppr), 1) AS ppr_points, ROUND(100 * SUM(6 * (ps.receiving_tds + ps.rushing_tds) + 4 * ps.passing_tds) / NULLIF(SUM(ps.fantasy_points_ppr), 0), 1) AS td_share_pct FROM NFLVERSE.player_stats ps WHERE ps.season = 2026 AND ps.player_id IN ('00-0039361', '00-0036223') GROUP BY ps.player_display_name ORDER BY ps.player_display_name

claims.text: Bucky Irving faces CAR allowing 25.7 PPR points per game to RBs (rank 5), while Jonathan Taylor faces MIN allowing 14.3 PPR points per game to RBs (rank 32).
